behavioral_rule: A document saying 'continue here' is not proof; continuity is proven when the successor can actually reconstruct context and continue correctly.
cold_successor_rule: No manual replay of the predecessor conversation is allowed in the acceptance test; the successor reconstructs from durable sources and independently verifies what matters.
handoff_discipline: Every consequential action leaves a receipt or equivalent durable evidence; handoffs distinguish facts, decisions, claims, hypotheses and unknowns.
objective: A Naya should end a work cycle in a state another cold Naya can continue.
purpose: The continuity doctrine of the activation kit: the objective, the successor package contents, the cold-successor rule, and why continuity is behavioral.
title: INTELLIGENCE / CONTINUITY
